context: Yuki sets up utilities for a new apartment with Kenji.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: home setup; vocabulary (設備/風呂/支払い/印刷/合計) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新しい部屋の設備、整えたいの。
lines.en: I want to set up the new room's facilities.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: お風呂の設備は、新しいですか?
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、お風呂は最新の設備なんです。
lines.en: Yes, the bath has the latest equipment.
lines.style: clear office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 支払いの手続きは、済みましたか?
lines.en: Have the payment procedures been done?
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 支払いは、来月からです。
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 契約書を、印刷しておきましょう。
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 印刷したら、合計の金額を確認します。
lines.en: After printing, I'll check the total amount.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 合計が、予算内なら安心ですね。
lines.en: If the total's within budget, you're set.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
